claim: Let \(H\) be the Heawood graph, realized as the point-line incidence graph of the Fano plane with points \(p_i\) and lines \(\ell_i\) for \(i\in\mathbb Z/7\mathbb Z\), where \(p_j\) is adjacent to \(\ell_i\) exactly when \(j-i\in\{0,1,3\}\). Then its independence complex satisfies \(\operatorname{Ind}(H)\simeq\bigvee^{6}S^{3}\).

integrity.proof_basis: exhaustive face enumeration, a complete acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and an independent finite-field homology replay
integrity.unproved_limits: No family-level statement is claimed for projective-plane incidence graphs or cubic bipartite graphs.

limitations: Single-graph result; no general projective-plane formula is claimed.
Originality is assessed only against the explicitly inspected sources and recorded searches.
title: The Heawood independence complex is \(\bigvee^{6}S^{3}\)
